400 INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_STORAGE hasn't been enabled for project <project>.
Consider using one of the following SQL statements to enable data collection:
  ALTER PROJECT `<project>`
  SET OPTIONS (`region-us.enable_info_schema_storage` = TRUE)

Or to enable for the entire organization:
  ALTER ORGANIZATION
  SET OPTIONS (`region-us.enable_info_schema_storage` = TRUE)

Note that if you need to query the _BY_ORGANIZATION tables,
use the ALTER ORGANIZATION statement in order to see all tables in the organization.
You will need the bigquery.config.update permission on the organization or project
in order to run the above SQL statements.
The bigquery.admin role includes this permission.

After enabling, please allow around 1 day for the complete historical data to become available.
